subject: Smoke full candidate suite (all 18, 1 trial, 3 arms) + classify KB-dependent vs solo-able
description: Run the 15 not-yet-smoked candidates × arms [off, on-search, on-gated] at trial 0 (45 solves), reuse the 3 already done (bench-metric, locale-sum, interval-merge), run the learning-journal reducer over the full set, and classify each of the 18 candidates as KB-DEPENDENT (solved_delta=+1, OFF fails / KB rescues) vs SOLO-ABLE (solved_delta=0). This classification picks the balanced multi-trial set. Validates the whole suite end-to-end before scaling.
